rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
depicted_variant: Kerang monster raksasa dari laut dalam Tahiti sedang menyedot air dan perahu ke dalam cangkangnya.

visual_requirements.description: Satu kerang raksasa bercangkang bivalvia, dua katup bergerigi alami dan mantel lembut; tanpa mata, gigi vertebrata atau tentakel karangan.
Arus air menyedot perahu kecil menuju bukaan kerang yang menelan pelayar.
Laut dalam pada perjalanan laut Tahiti menuju Pitcairn.

aura: Skala kerang monster raksasa c01 dan arus penyedot kapal c05, bukan aura.
artistic_choices: Anatomi dipertahankan sebagai kerang bivalvia; warna cangkang/mantel editorial, tanpa fitur predator baru.
Perahu kecil memberi skala terdokumentasi; tanpa orang/korban tampak. Kamera setengah bawah air mengutamakan makhluk.
prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Pua Tu Tahi, the giant monster clam of the deep in Tahitian Rata legends [pua-tu-tahi-c01].
ANATOMY: exactly one vast bivalve clam with two thick ridged calcified shell valves opening like a stone gateway, fleshy dark mantle lining the interior and natural scalloped shell margins. NO eyes, teeth, face, arms or tentacles [pua-tu-tahi-c01].
MOMENT: gaping directly toward the viewer while drawing a small empty ocean voyaging canoe toward its opening; great heavy upper shell looms overhead and lower shell thrusts into foreground.
POWER: a forceful current SUCKS water and the small canoe down toward the interior, physically expressed by spiraling foam, bubbles and streaming silt, the documented swallowing force [pua-tu-tahi-c04, pua-tu-tahi-c05]. No magical glow.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low underwater angle just before the opening; the clam fills nearly the whole square, the canoe at the top is tiny against its enormous shell.
LIGHT & WEATHER: single cold moonbeam penetrates dark water from above, warm antique-gold highlights on shell edges, deep walnut shadows inside.
SURFACE: massive rough calcified ridges, barnacle texture, wet fleshy mantle, suspended silt.
SETTING: dark Pacific ocean depths on the Tahitian voyage toward Pitcairn [pua-tu-tahi-c01, pua-tu-tahi-c04].
MOOD: crushingly immense, terrifying swallowing presence, never an ordinary seafood still life or decorative shell.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no people, bones or gore; no invented eyes, jaws, teeth, limbs or tentacles; no text, logo, frame, border or watermark; no borrowed design; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons or luminous mist.
